LESSON: PRESENTATION

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: LITERACY ACTIVITIES
Strand: LISTENING AND 1.4 Talk about By the end of the sub-strand, the learner  Learner
Topic 1.5: Presentation

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Presentation. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: what we have chosen?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. question the decisions made in their environment and ask critical questions
2. engage in decision making in their environment.
3. sequentially position their views using appropriate words e.g firstly, secondly, lastly
4. demonstrate an interest in making 176 decisions in their environment through contributions and valid suggestions basis for initiating conversation on a topic

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. question the decisions made in their environment and ask critical questions
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to question the decisions made in their environment and ask critical questions. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. engage in decision making in their environment.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to engage in decision making in their environment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. sequentially position their views using appropriate words e.g firstly, secondly, lastly
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to sequentially position their views using appropriate words e.g firstly, secondly, lastly. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. demonstrate an interest in making 176 decisions in their environment through contributions and valid suggestions basis for initiating conversation on a topic
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to demonstrate an interest in making 176 decisions in their environment through contributions and valid suggestions basis for initiating conversation on a topic. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Presentation using something you see at school.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Presentation.
2. Explain Presentation to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Presentation.
4. Show that you can: question the decisions made in their environment and ask critical questions
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Presentation. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: what we have chosen?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. question the decisions made in their environment and ask critical questions
2. engage in decision making in their environment.
3. sequentially position their views using appropriate words e.g firstly, secondly, lastly
4. demonstrate an interest in making 176 decisions in their environment through contributions and valid suggestions basis for initiating conversation on a topic

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
